notes: Game rules per mode. 'defaults' applies to every mode; each block under 'modes' overrides only what it lists. Times are in seconds, distances in metres, health in HP. Cosmetics never appear here. See docs/PLAN.md section 2.

Hub.notes: The lobby house: ready up, choose a mode, try outfits. Knockouts come straight back.

Tutorial.notes: Local only. Seven steps against a training dummy; nothing ends the round early.

Dibs.notes: Free-for-all. Last player standing takes the round; first to 3 rounds wins. The Movers close one outer room every 25 s from 45 s; the playroom never closes.

Duos.notes: 2v2. Last team standing. At 0 HP you are downed and a teammate can revive you.

MovingOut.notes: Co-op escape for 2-4 players on one team: find 3 keepsakes and reach the van in the living room before the Movers pack the house. Rooms close away from the van.

MovingDay.notes: Co-op placement: put the checklist furniture in the right rooms before time runs out. Placed checklist items don't count towards maxDeployed.
